# SpontaneousActivityDynamics

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The intrinsic, unstimulated firing patterns of neural organoids that exhibit structured temporal and spatial correlations, serving as a substrate for emergent computation. Establishes a baseline for how in-network neuromorphic systems might leverage intrinsic dynamics for energy-efficient, event-driven processing without external clocks.
